2946-3845-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-3845-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3845-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-653-728.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-728.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-5571-7666--6.description:
Use Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-2438-3545.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

549-4693-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-4693-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Overgrown Estate.

1563-2457-2837-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

475-2919-3197-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-2919-3197-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4506-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4506-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

104-475-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1292-3117-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1292-3117-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-5414-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-5414-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-5414-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

1462-6801-7487.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-6801-7487.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-6801-7487.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

147-6798-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6798-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6798-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

240-997-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

967-2292-3809-6441-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

967-2921-3809-6753-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2558-3698-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Grinding Station and Sokka and Suki's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-5659-7060.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5659-7060.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-5147-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1495-2313-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Conclave Mentor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-2313-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1477-1808-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1477-1808-6291.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2034-2178-4681-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2034-2178-4681-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

813-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Scholar of the Ages each turn.
813-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Scholar of the Ages from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4365-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4365-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4365-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 3.

1418-3484-3921-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1418-3484-3921-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

467-3384-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness if it is a creature.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
467-3384-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw four cards, discard a card and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Shorikai and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

2906-4489.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
Opponents have lost at least three life this turn.
2906-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

3198-4839-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Viashino Sandscout by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Viashino Sandscout.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Viashino Sandscout triggers, returning itself and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

539-862-1339-2232-3848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-862-1339-2232-3848.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Omnath's second ability.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2122-2275-4017-4134.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Mindless Automaton.
You have a way to draw a card.
2122-2275-4017-4134.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain two life.
Mindless Automaton triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

690-1545-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-1545-4658.description:
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
